purpose: Snow questions were sent to the wrong tool. On 2026-11-12 the owner's end-to-end test on mcp.hoodoowx.com asked 'How much snow has Denver had so far this season?'. Claude called get_water_year_status, which answers rain only, and then said Hoodoo doesn't measure snowfall. get_climate_context answers this question correctly. This test checks a description-only fix. Tool names, arguments and behaviour are unchanged. Written and committed before any API call.

versions.D: Live. The six descriptions served by 8c174b1 (release/2026-11-rename, live since 2026-11-12). The file is version D of the 2026-11-03 trigger test, copied unchanged from branch hoodoo-trigger-test-2026-11-03 in ~/Projects/baseline. Before the copy was used, its descriptions and input schemas were checked equal, byte for byte, to what 8c174b1's server lists. File: snow_routing_test_2026-11-12/version_D.json.
versions.E: New. Version D with the descriptions of get_climate_context, get_water_year_status and compare_to_normal replaced by the text on branch fix/2026-11-snow-tool-descriptions, read from the server's own list_tools. All else is identical to D: the names, schemas, the other three descriptions, server label 'hoodoo' (tool names hoodoo__<tool>), and the get_weather_forecast distractor tool. File: snow_routing_test_2026-11-12/version_E.json.

method.harness: snow_routing_test_2026-11-12/harness/run_addendum.py, with rerun_hoodoo.py and run_routing.py beside it. These are copied unchanged from docs/hoodoo_trigger_test_2026-10-20/harness on branch hoodoo-trigger-test-2026-11-03 in ~/Projects/baseline, and are the same harness the 2026-11-03 test used. It is resumable, saves after every call, retries only connection errors and 5xx (twice), and stops the whole run on any 4xx. Run with anthropic 0.109.2 (~/.venvs/baseline-test).
method.call: messages.create(model, max_tokens=1024, tools=version tools, messages=[one user message]); no system prompt. The model's first response is scored.
method.key: BASELINE_TEST_ANTHROPIC_KEY from ~/.config/baseline/anthropic_tests.env, read by run_routing.load_key(); never printed.
method.scored_measure: The first tool called in the response (first tool_use block). A response with no tool call scores as 'none'.
order: 1. Snow test under D (live): python run_addendum.py ../snow_routing_test_2026-11-12.json .. D ../results_snow_D.jsonl
2. Snow test under E (new): the same command with E and results_snow_E.jsonl

3. The original trigger test under E: python run_addendum.py ../trigger_questions_2026-11-03.json .. E ../results_trigger_E.jsonl. Its 29 questions are copied verbatim from ~/Projects/baseline docs/hoodoo_trigger_test_2026-11-03.json. It is scored by score_trigger_E.py, which passes the E rows unchanged to score_hoodoo.py and score_addendum2.py in the version C slot, the same way score_D.py did for D.

cost.prices_per_million_tokens: Opus 5.5 $4 in / $20 out, Sonnet 5.5 $2 / $10, Haiku 5.5 $0.10 / $0.50 (the same list prices as the 2026-11-03 STATUS)
cost.estimate: From the 2026-11-03 run's recorded usage, the cost is $0.153 per question of 9 runs, at an average of 5,745 input and about 530 output tokens per call. E's descriptions are 637 characters longer, about 3% more input. This test has 20 questions x 2 versions plus 29 trigger questions, so 69 question-sets and 621 calls, for about $10.7. The worst case, with every reply at 1,024 output tokens, is $0.201 per question-set, or about $13.9.
cost.stop_rule: Cost is totalled from recorded usage after each stage. Before starting a stage, if the spend so far plus that stage's worst case would pass $15, stop and report to the owner instead of running it.

pass_criteria.snow: For every snow question (group 'snow'), under version E, hoodoo__get_climate_context is the first tool called in 9 of 9 runs.
pass_criteria.control: Each control question (group 'control') is checked against its own live result. Let m be the first tool most often called under D, and n_D its count out of 9. The question passes if, under E, m is also the first tool most often called, and its count n_E is at least n_D - 1. The one-run allowance is the same noise allowance as the earlier tests' 8-of-9 rule. The exact counts are reported, so a stricter reading (n_E >= n_D) can be applied from the table. If D's top tool is a tie, the question passes if E's top tool is one of the tied tools and its count is at least the tie count minus 1.
pass_criteria.trigger_rerun: The original trigger test passes under E by the criteria in ~/Projects/baseline docs/hoodoo_trigger_test_2026-11-03.json (the C criteria, applied to E): trigger questions have a Hoodoo tool first in at least 8 of 9 runs; misfire questions call any Hoodoo tool in at most 1 of 9; forecast questions call get_weather_forecast first in at least 8 of 9; everyday 'who do' questions call a Hoodoo tool first in at most 1 of 9; dictation questions are reported only.
pass_criteria.overall: The fix passes only if all three hold: every snow question, every control question, and the trigger rerun. If API errors leave a question with fewer than 9 completed runs under a version, the test is incomplete, not passed.
pass_criteria.expected_under_D: Not a pass condition. The live run should show the problem: some snow questions going to a tool other than get_climate_context (S01 is the owner's question). If D sends every snow question to get_climate_context 9 of 9, that is reported as a finding: the test did not reproduce the problem.

amendment_1.written: 2026-11-12, after the D (live) run and before any E call
amendment_1.what: Version E also edits compare_locations. One sentence is added after 'not by your own arithmetic.': 'A question about one place, snow included ("How much snow has Denver had so far this season?"), goes to get_climate_context: don't add other places to make it a comparison.' version_E.json was rebuilt from the server and now differs from D in four descriptions: get_climate_context, get_water_year_status, compare_to_normal and compare_locations.
amendment_1.why: This change was made after seeing the D results. The questions, runs, criteria and scorer are unchanged. Under D, most snow questions went first to compare_locations, the only description that names snowfall. The model added places nobody asked about to fit it: S01 'Denver' became ['Denver, CO', 'Boulder, CO'] with variable snowfall and period ski_season. Across the 99 snow runs, the first tool was compare_locations in 70, get_climate_context in 16, compare_to_normal in 8 (all on S11), get_water_year_status in 4 and get_weather_forecast in 1. That is the clear case that the brief requires before one of the other four descriptions is changed.
amendment_1.cost_check: D cost $2.56 (recorded usage). The worst case for E is about $4.2 and for the trigger rerun about $5.9, so the worst-case total is about $12.6, under the $15 cap.

also_reported: For each question and version, the first-tool counts by tool and by model, and the arguments of any call to a Hoodoo tool other than get_climate_context on a snow question. Where the reply text says Hoodoo can't measure or doesn't have snow, that is also counted (a case-insensitive scan of the text for 'snow' near a negation). This count is reported only, not scored.
notes: The distractor get_weather_forecast tool is kept, so the tool set matches the earlier trigger tests. It offers precipitation for the next 7 days. Snow questions about past or to-date snow should not go to it. S11 is a snow forecast question, which tests the compare_to_normal edit.
C07 is a snow question about two places. By its description it belongs to compare_locations, so it is a control, not a snow question.
predicted_tool on control questions is the tester's guess, made before the run. It is not the criterion; D's result is.
